reasons: CS4350 requires CS3247, which requires CS3241. CS3241 requires CS2030S (completed) and CS2040S (completed), so CS3241 is eligible in Sem 5. However, CS3247 is only offered in Sem 2. CS3241 is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2. To take CS3247 in Sem 6 (exchange, 0 MC) is impossible as it's 4 MC. To take CS3247 in Sem 8, CS3241 must be taken in Sem 7 or earlier. CS3241 is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2. Sem 7 is Y4S1 (odd), Sem 8 is Y4S2 (even). CS3241 is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2, which correspond to odd and even semesters generally, but specifically 'Sem 1' and 'Sem 2' in the record usually mean the first and second semester of the academic year. Let's re-read the offering rule: 'Offered: Sem 1' means odd semesters. 'Offered: Sem 1, Sem 2' means both. CS3241 is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2. So it can be taken in Sem 7 (Y4S1, odd) or Sem 8 (Y4S2, even)? No, 'Sem 1' in the record maps to odd semesters (1,3,5,7) and 'Sem 2' maps to even semesters (2,4,6,8). So CS3241 can be taken in Sem 7 or 8. If taken in Sem 7, CS3247 (Sem 2 only, i.e., even semesters 2,4,6,8) can be taken in Sem 8. Then CS4350 (Sem 1 only, i.e., odd semesters 1,3,5,7) cannot be taken in Sem 8. CS4350 is offered in Sem 1. So it must be taken in an odd semester. The latest odd semester is Sem 7. To take CS4350 in Sem 7, CS3247 must be completed in Sem 6 or earlier. CS3247 is offered in Sem 2 (even). So it can be taken in Sem 4 or Sem 6. Sem 6 is exchange (0 MC), so CS3247 cannot be taken in Sem 6. So CS3247 must be taken in Sem 4. Then CS3241 must be taken in Sem 3 or earlier. Sem 3 is Y2S1. The student is currently in Sem 4 (Y2S2). So Sem 3 is in the past. The student has not completed CS3241. Therefore, CS3241 cannot be taken in Sem 3. It can be taken in Sem 5 (Y3S1, odd) or Sem 7 (Y4S1, odd). If taken in Sem 5, CS3247 can be taken in Sem 6 (exchange, no) or Sem 8 (even). If CS3247 is taken in Sem 8, CS4350 (Sem 1/odd) cannot be taken in Sem 8. CS4350 must be taken in Sem 7. But CS3247 is not completed by Sem 7 if taken in Sem 8. If CS3247 is taken in Sem 4, CS3241 must be taken in Sem 3 (past) or Sem 1 (past). Thus, it is impossible to complete the prerequisite chain for CS4350 given the current semester and exchange constraints.
